Name: Next Meeting
Author: René Reimann
Description: Shows the next event from the local macOS Calendar on a Stream Deck + dial, with the time remaining until it starts. Rotate to browse upcoming events, press to join the meeting. Reads EventKit directly, so no calendar feed URLs are needed.

Actions.Name: Next Meeting
Actions.Tooltip: Next calendar event with a countdown. Rotate to browse upcoming events, press to open the meeting link.
